children: Fidelity corrected July and August 2026 refinance opened order metrics, reporting July up ~15% and August down ~5% year-over-year.
Filed an 8-K to correct prior statements made at Barclays Global Financial Services Conference.
July 2026 refinance opened orders were up approximately 15% year-over-year, not down 5% as previously stated.
August 2026 refinance opened orders were down approximately 5% year-over-year, not down in the mid-30% range.
Clarification does not affect previously announced financial results or SEC filings.
